summary: Albert Clark, 33, a Crested Butte local, collapsed and died of unknown non-trauma-related causes while skinning uphill in the Coney's Ridge area off Washington Gulch Road; two companions performed CPR for 30+ minutes until ~15 Crested Butte SAR members arrived, confirmed he was deceased, and transported him to the trailhead.
location: Coney's Ridge area off Washington Gulch Road
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mt. Crested Butte Police
notes: 911 call 12:25 p.m.; helicopter on standby; celebration of life Jan 23 per article. Parent-opened run 585.
